panel_descriptions.neg_0: A large ring traced by circular beads surrounds an inward zigzag and a descending row of triangles; the inner angular trace remains an open branch joined to the beaded ring.
panel_descriptions.neg_1: Two similarly rounded wedge-shaped loops meet tip-to-tip at a central point, forming an hourglass arrangement.
panel_descriptions.neg_2: A small triangular loop meets the top vertex of a larger straight-sided quadrilateral loop; both loops are angular polygons.
panel_descriptions.neg_3: Two similarly rounded sector-like loops share one central vertex and fan outward in adjacent directions.
panel_descriptions.neg_4: Three narrow straight-edged triangular forms converge around one central junction, producing an entirely angular assembly.
panel_descriptions.neg_5: A curved arch and a circular-bead chain form a rounded enclosure, while a zigzag and short triangular chain descend from its lower junction as an open angular branch.
panel_descriptions.pos_0: A thick rounded arc joins an upper triangular-chain endpoint to a lower circular-chain endpoint, creating a rounded outer loop; a compact angular triangular-chain loop meets it near the central cluster.
panel_descriptions.pos_1: Circular, triangular, zigzag, and straight carriers form two touching bounded loops, with a rounded beaded side and a sharply turning angular circuit meeting at the central junction.
panel_descriptions.pos_2: A thick curved arc closes one bounded loop through rows of circles and triangles, while a compact angular triangular circuit meets it in the central knot.
panel_descriptions.pos_3: A large semicircular loop with a straight vertical side meets a small sharp triangular loop at its upper junction.
panel_descriptions.pos_4: A curved sector-shaped loop and a straight-sided quadrilateral loop touch at a single central vertex.
panel_descriptions.pos_5: A circular-bead arc participates in a rounded loop at the left, while a compact sharp-cornered loop involving zigzag, triangular, and quadrilateral segments meets it at the central junction.
